# RPPhone visual adaptation

Original work: **RPPhone**, version **0.0.58**, by **NewbKodii**.
Source: <https://reforger.armaplatform.com/workshop/65EF7B586691A802-RPPhone>.
License: **Arma Public License (APL)**:
<https://www.bohemia.net/en/licenses/arma-public-license>.

This folder contains the unmodified phone-frame and message-icon textures from
RPPhone, registered under new Axum resource IDs, and an adapted phone interface.
On October 15, 2026, Project Axum added its own navigation, contact conversations,
quantity controls, offers and appointment display. RPPhone's banking, jobs,
policing, vehicle and payment controllers are not included. Exact source and
destination paths, hashes, and modification notes are in `provenance.json`.
